description: This file contains a PHP class named WikiDiff3 that implements a diff algorithm based on the Longest Common Subsequence (LCS) and Myers' algorithm variations. It provides methods for computing differences between sequences, including range differences and heuristic optimizations. The class is accompanied by a RangeDifference class for representing ranges of differences.

classes.name: WikiDiff3
classes.description: A class implementing a diff algorithm for comparing sequences using a variation of Myers' LCS algorithm, supporting heuristics and range-based diffing.

classes.name: RangeDifference
classes.description: A helper class representing a range of changes between two sequences, specified by start and end indices for left and right ranges.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the diff engine with optional limits for performance.

methods.name: diff
methods.description: Computes the differences between two arrays (sequences) and updates internal state to reflect added and removed ranges.

methods.name: diff_range
methods.description: Performs a diff between two sequences and returns a list of RangeDifference objects indicating ranges that differ.

methods.name: getLcsLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the Longest Common Subsequence, adjusting for heuristic use if necessary.
